reviewAdjustments: Motion uses opaque new tabs/subviews and avoids creating the outgoing snapshot; preserves whole-group ownership and no rewind watchdog.
Question dates canonicalized; explicit year, selected scope, actual timestamp cutoff and unknown products handled without whole-business fallthrough.
Historical names and buyer identity; unknown classification stays unknown, missing costs and zero revenue do not fabricate margin.
Payment-use frequency separated from amount and no claim of settlement.
Brain completion tied to the exact open sheet and data owner.
Stock acknowledgment rechecked, durably saved and rolled back on failure; notifications recheck acknowledgment after permission.
About page accurately discloses optional configured external AI requests.
